card.name: Size and speed of motion words
card.fires_on: Quantity words such as speed, magnitude, direction, far and movement, mostly in physics-style problems about a moving object. Also fires on a stray number inside a numeric table.

modes.label: Physics motion words
modes.description: Words naming how fast, how far or in what direction something moves, in a hurricane word problem.
modes.example: the course of the hurricane suddenly shifts due north, and its<< speed>> slows to 25.0 km

modes.label: Magnitude of an effect
modes.description: The word magnitude used for the size of an effect or interaction.
modes.example: minimize the<< magnitude>> or duration of the hypotensive effect

modes.label: Numbers in a table
modes.description: A digit inside a row of numeric values.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are a mixed set with no clear theme, so the output effect is unclear.
